Script-visible WebGPU error scopes for the scripted binding: native device work runs in validation, out-of-memory and internal device scopes and routes what they catch to the script's own scope, so script sees its errors and the uncaptured-error callback stays quiet. Vellum wrote this; Pulp's binding runs no error scopes.

The sealed V8 provider's consumer_defines, applied to the imported target so every translation unit that includes V8 headers compiles with the library's ABI. Pulp's tools/cmake/PulpV8ConsumerDefines.cmake respelled under Vellum names; the Pulp spelling would raise the framework name debt.

Resolves the sealed V8 provider for VELLUM_ENABLE_V8 from Vellum's dependency lock: the digest-checked v8-builder archive, its manifest paired with the renderer lock's Skia and Dawn, and a per-file receipt. Vellum's counterpart to Pulp's tools/cmake/FindV8.cmake for its one platform.

Frame-level render pass manager: ordered background, content, effects, overlay and post-effect passes with a per-frame time budget and the whole-recording GPU render time, read by the inspector, the motion cost view and the UI preview. Distinct from the custom GPU pass API of Generous-Corp/vellum#432.

Native emit API (plain C functions) from the renderer's frame trace to the framework's Perfetto session, so one trace carries the framework's and the renderer's tracks. Vellum wrote this; Pulp has no frame trace. It names no renderer type and compiles to no-op stubs unless VELLUM_ENABLE_TRACING is on. Scoped to macOS for now.
